name: experience-niho-account-status-api
deploymentNote: Consumer proposal aligned to NIHO PR #21003. Do not enable EXPERIENCE_NIHO_ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHECK_ENABLED until this fixed NIHO source is merged and deployed, then staging accepts the batch API.
scope: POST /api/experience-host/account-statuses with the Experience service ID token only
Batch read active, inactive, unknown, or merged status for IDs with niho-experience AppConnection history
Return results in request order with currentUserId null except for merged entries
Resolve merged source IDs to the current NIHO user ID
excludedScope: NIHO user tokens or browser calls
Status lookups for IDs never connected to this service
Session storage, authorization or content migration outside current NIHO ID bindings
